# Saltbeck Sluice Works - intake controller

The intake controller service trips whenever the grill is blocked, and it has to come back without a fitter on site.
The settings the fitters discussed are carded in units/restart-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Saltbeck Sluice Works runs an intake controller that trips whenever the grill is blocked, and the controller has to come back on its own after such a trip. When a fitter stops the service on purpose to work on the sluice it has to stay stopped until the sluice is declared fit. Give the service-manager setting that brings the service back only after it stopped with a failure. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
